name: Remembrance
overview: Scripture reveals remembrance as a vital spiritual practice that honors God's faithfulness and redemptive work. The Passover feast, established in Exodus 12:14, serves as a perpetual memorial to God's deliverance, while Jesus institutes the Lord's Supper in Luke 22:19 as a continual act of remembering His sacrificial body. The Psalms exhort believers to not forget God's benefits (Psalm 103:2) and lament the absence of remembrance beyond death (Psalm 6:5), emphasizing the importance of conscious gratitude in life. Isaiah 43:26 highlights the need to be reminded in order to plead and be justified, underscoring remembrance as essential for a right relationship with God.
